note: DRAFT for Aaron to read (coach-spec §3 'Final rep / RIR numbers per goal'). Reps are [low, high]; rir is the target reps in reserve. Where rir is a pair [a, b], 2+ years gets a and everyone else b. Under 6 months never goes below RIR 2.

roles.main: The day's one heavy compound. Never trimmed.
roles.secondary: A second compound or close variation.
roles.accessory: Isolation and support work. Trimmed from the end when time is short.

event.note: One event slot (carry, load or press) on the template's eventDay, after the main lift. Logged as a B1 shape: weight + distance/time, not reps.

powerlifting.label: Powerlifting meet
powerlifting.note: Competition squat, bench and deadlift are the main lifts (patterns.json goalOverrides). With a meet date the plan becomes a C6 block counting down to it.

fat-loss.label: Lose weight
fat-loss.note: Keep lifting fairly heavy so the weight lost is fat, not muscle (Aaron, 2026-11-05: added for gen-pop users). Nutrition and the target-weight goal do the rest.

move.label: Move better, ease aches
move.note: Gentle loading for everyday strength and joints: moderate reps, plenty in reserve (Aaron, 2026-11-05).

sets.note: Working sets per slot, by experience (Q6). Warm-ups are extra and come from the ramp.

under6m.loadStep: +2.5 kg only after every set reaches the top of the range at the target RIR, two sessions running

6mTo2y.loadStep: +2.5 kg when every set reaches the top of the range at the target RIR (the D5 double progression)

over2y.loadStep: Autoregulated from the working e1RM (autoreg-spec); A weeks the heavy main lift, B weeks its variation

minutes.note: Slots kept per day from the top of the list; main never cut. At 45 min and under, kept accessories and finishers are paired into supersets (1+2, 3+4...) and marked in the exercise notes (Aaron, 2026-11-02).

fromFittingTest.note: coach-spec §1b: what a fitting test changes, locally.
fromFittingTest.ankles: plates-under-heels note on squat slots; calves kept
fromFittingTest.grip: farmers carry replaces one finisher a week
